task: Turn a screenshot or scan of a ruled table into an Excel spreadsheet
packaging_note: Uses img2table 2.0.0 with local English Tesseract OCR.

inputs.what: one clear PNG or JPEG of a printed English table with visible cell borders

outputs.what: an Excel workbook with one sheet per detected table

known_issues: Faint rules, merged cells and low-resolution images can cause errors. Check the cells against the original before using the numbers. Handwriting and borderless tables are outside this recipe.
